column1: Where does the new element belong by cmp, and which links have to change to put it there? When the new value belongs before the current first node, does *begin_list itself need to change? After the insertion, does the list still reach every node it held before?

The elements these tests make come from the grader's own ft_create_elem, as the subject says they will from exercise 01 on, never from your ex00: a red here is this exercise's own. Is the prototype layer green too? It checks that your ft_list.h holds the t_list the subject prints, which the grader's elements are built on.
